reason: Adds public disclosure: "update the public version of the RSP before any changes take effect and record any differences from the prior draft in a change log".
Only footnote marker changes ("additional10" to "additional8"); CCL definition otherwise identical.
"utilizes" becomes "may utilize"; scope loses "large-scale violence, terrorism" and "major cyber weapons", despite adding "internal benchmarks" (MIX).
"visible to the BoD and within OpenAI" narrowed to employees who "may also request and receive a summary"; BoD visibility dropped.
Adds "updated at least once a year" but drops "we will publish substantive revisions"; mixed directions coded W (MIX).
Earlier forwarding to Leadership "sharing also with the BoD and Preparedness" is dropped; later only recommendations "to OpenAI Leadership, as well as rationale" (MIX).
Trigger broadened from "CCL" to "T/CCL" and scope extended to "ML R&D and Misalignment T/CCL".
Forecast trigger "(or are forecasted to reach)" dropped; later applies only to systems that "cross this capability threshold".
Work on "identifying enforceable critical steps" dropped; replaced by benchmark evaluation "for cyber capabilities, cyber refusals" (MIX).
Identical text: "We plan to release an updated version of this policy within three months."
"we intend to utilize tiered availability" becomes present-tense practice "xAI employs tiered availability".
"we would take steps to stop or prevent that event" becomes "we may take steps such as the following".
"we will be running them" on fine-tuned versions becomes "intended to approximate", with finetuning only "if the weights will be released" (MIX).
Shutdown trigger lowered from increasing likelihood of "a catastrophic event" to "a risk".
Explicit "red-teaming must include this use of these modalities" replaced by descriptive "may be difficult or impossible", limited to "unmoderated" access for "untrusted users".
Per-category trigger persists: systems that "cross this capability threshold" require safeguards, equivalent to triggering on "any of the tracked risk categories".
Only adds "security" to an illustrative list introduced by "which could include"; rule unchanged.
"SAG membership will rotate yearly" reworded as "SAG members serve for one year terms"; rest identical.
Drops "sufficient to prevent... stolen by a motivated non-state actor" and distillation measures; adds "NIST 800-171" and "SOC 2" (MIX).
Adds "Harmful Manipulation" domain and "misalignment CCLs"; "attack" broadened to "threat".
Adds requirement to "make a compelling case" for threat mapping and that no unevaluated threat model "represents a substantial amount of risk".
"a threat actor's ability" reworded to "the ability"; same "We may take into account" modal.
Identical text about equipping "the model with appropriate scaffolding and other augmentations".
Renaming to "FAIF" and adding "including catastrophic risks" within "significant risks" does not change coverage.
Adds "Pre-deployment reviews include assessing benchmark results" and internal-use review "before extensive rollout", plus updates "before major new capabilities".
Identical Cyber uplift level 1 definition; only table caption "CCLs" to "CCL".
Removes "should be extended further by monitoring for scaled abuse that performs prompt-based model detail extraction (e.g. distillation attacks)".
Identical text on heightened safeguards and "more than one hundred deaths or over $1 billion".
Discretionary "we may notify" becomes "xAI will provide the relevant authorities with a copy of the incident report" when legally reportable.
Continuous "dynamic (i.e., frequently updated) Scorecard" including "post-mitigation risk" replaced by "Prior to deployment" Capabilities Report (MIX).
"Evaluations may also consist of multiple difficulty stages" becomes "We will first conduct preliminary assessments (on both new and existing models)".
"We intend to regularly evaluate" becomes present-tense practice "xAI regularly evaluates the adequacy and reliability".
"may be supplemented" becomes "We conduct further analysis", adding "external evaluations, and post-market monitoring".
Only adds heading "Supply chain:"; vendor review text identical.
"Each quarter" report "to our board and LTBT" becomes "regularly update the Board"; LTBT and ad hoc sooner updates dropped.
"We will explore" to "xAI is exploring" is will-to-present (11.1); added detail is illustrative.
Mandatory audits "will be audited by qualified, independent third-parties" become "If we deem" warranted, "when available and feasible".
"one possible mitigation" that "may be applied" becomes "we will carry out periodic residual risk assessments" and safeguards "will be applied".
Illustrative "may be triggered, for example" becomes fixed trigger: assessments "upon the completion of a post-training run".
Identical text on identifying "critical steps" and "redundant layers of safeguards".
